task: Implement validate_schema for the API gateway without using config-service validation rules.

candidate_memories.content: API gateway validate_schema checks request payload shape against the published OpenAPI spec.
API gateway schema validation must use the OpenAPI spec, not the config service schema registry.
Gateway validation is stateless; it does not call external services during the hot request path.
When validate_schema appears in multiple services, confirm the target data source before coding.
Config service: validate_schema resolves tenant config keys against an internal schema registry.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: config service validation logic would break the stateless gateway requirement

candidate_memories.content: Old integration note says schema validation could be centralized to reduce duplication.
